# Medical News Today

> Medical News Today is a comprehensive health information platform providing evidence-backed resources on diseases, conditions, treatments, and wellness topics.

Medical News Today offers science-backed guides and news covering major health conditions including cancer, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, neurological disorders, and mental health. The site serves as a trusted medical reference with detailed condition guides, treatment information, and health equity resources for both patients and healthcare consumers.

## Key Topics

- Cancer
- Cardiovascular Health
- Diabetes
- COVID-19
- Alzheimer's & Dementia
- Mental Health & Anxiety
- HIV & AIDS
- Neurological Disorders
- Dermatological Conditions
- Women's Health
- Exercise & Fitness
- Health Equity
- Symptom Management
- Treatment Guides
- Medical Reference

## Major Health Conditions

- [Cancer: Resources on diagnosis, treatment, and more](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/cancer): Comprehensive cancer resource with news, types, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment guide
- [Cardiovascular health: Heart-healthy, science-backed resources](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/cardiovascular-health): Heart health resources on disease, blood pressure, stroke, diet, and fitness
- [Diabetes](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/diabetes): In-depth diabetes resource for type 1, type 2, gestational diabetes management
- [Dementia: Resources on Alzheimer's and other dementias](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/alzheimers-and-dementia): Science-backed guide to Alzheimer's disease and dementia symptoms, management, care
- [HIV and AIDS](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/hiv-and-aids): Research-backed HIV and AIDS information on symptoms, treatments, and life

## Cancer & Oncology

- [Breast cancer: Resources on symptoms, treatment, and more.](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/breast-cancer): Breast cancer resource covering risk factors, symptoms, diagnosis, stages, treatment
- [Leukemia: Resources on symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/leukemia): Leukemia resource covering ALL, AML, CLL, CML symptoms, diagnosis, treatment

## Mental Health & Neurological Disorders

- [Anxiety: Resources on symptoms, treatment, and more](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/anxiety): Comprehensive anxiety resource covering symptoms, causes, management, and treatment

## Respiratory & Dermatological Health

- [Asthma & allergies: Resources on management & treatment](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/asthma-and-allergies): Science-backed guide to asthma and allergy management, treatment, and prevention
- [Medical and health information | MedicalNewsToday](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/program/investigating-atopic-dermatitis): Atopic dermatitis investigation program with health guides and skin disease information

## Women's Health & Specialized Conditions

- [Endometriosis: Resources on symptoms, treatment, and more](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/endometriosis): Evidence-backed endometriosis guide covering symptoms, diagnosis, treatment
- [LGBTQIA+: Resources, information, education, and allyship](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/LGBTQIA): LGBTQIA+ health resources on gender identity, sexual health, mental health, care

## Wellness & Preventive Health

- [Exercise & fitness: In-depth resources for health and well-being](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/exercise-and-fitness): Science-backed exercise and fitness guide covering types, home workouts, weight management
- [Human biology: Insights into the human body](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/human-biology): In-depth human body resource covering nervous, cardiovascular, immune systems
- [Eye health: Resources for healthy vision](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/eye-health): Eye health resources on dry eye, vision loss, glaucoma, treatments, supplements
- [Headache and migraine: Resources backed by science](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/headache-and-migraine): Evidence-backed migraine and headache prevention, causes, management guide

## Health Equity & Public Health

- [COVID-19 (coronavirus): Latest news and developments](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/coronavirus): Latest COVID-19 news, symptoms, protection advice, and expert guidance
- [Health equity](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/health-equity): Health equity resource examining racial, social, and gender-related health disparities
- [Environment and sustainability: Caring for our health and our planet](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/environment-and-sustainability): Health impact of climate change, pollution, food sources, sustainability resources
